uk.question: Що таке RAG і який мінімальний pipeline тестувати?
uk.answer: RAG додає retrieved context до generation і може зменшити unsupported answers, але не усуває hallucinations. Pipeline: ingest → chunk → embed/index → retrieve → optional rerank → build context → generate → validate. Перевір lost text, chunk boundaries, relevant retrieval, context budget та відповідність citations реально використаним sources.

en.question: What is RAG and which minimal pipeline should be tested?
en.answer: RAG adds retrieved context to generation and may reduce unsupported answers but does not eliminate hallucinations. Pipeline: ingest → chunk → embed/index → retrieve → optional rerank → build context → generate → validate. Check lost text, chunk boundaries, relevant retrieval, context budgets and citations matching the sources actually used.

uk.question: Як перевіряти grounding, truncation, cache і stale sources?
uk.answer: Grounding перевіряй claim → supporting passage, а не лише існування URL. Додай факт на початок/кінець довгого context, змінений source і invalidated cache. Перевір document/version IDs, timestamp, retrieval access і cache key з user scope. Grounded answer може повторювати помилкове source, тому factual truth перевіряй окремо.

en.question: How are grounding, truncation, caches and stale sources checked?
en.answer: Check grounding as claim → supporting passage rather than URL existence alone. Add facts at the start/end of long contexts, changed sources and invalidated caches. Check document/version IDs, timestamps, retrieval access and user-scoped cache keys. Grounded answers may repeat false sources, so verify factual truth separately.

uk.question: Як виміряти retrieval quality на golden set?
uk.answer: Label relevant documents/passages для query. Precision@k = relevant retrieved / k; recall@k = relevant retrieved / all labeled relevant; MRR = mean reciprocal rank першого relevant result. Для менш ніж k results явно визнач denominator. Relevance@k не має одного універсального визначення: зафіксуй hit rate або graded score.

en.question: How is retrieval quality measured on a golden set?
en.answer: Label relevant documents/passages for each query. Precision@k = relevant retrieved / k; recall@k = relevant retrieved / all labelled relevant; MRR is the mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant result. Explicitly define the denominator when fewer than k results exist. Relevance@k is not universally defined: specify hit rate or a graded score.

uk.question: Як перевірити faithfulness і безпечно змінити pipeline?
uk.answer: Розбий answer на claims, знайди support/contradictions, рахуй supported claims і citation coverage для claims, що потребують source. Перевір sample людиною. Version chunker, embeddings, corpus, index і reranker; при зміні embedding зазвичай потрібна reindex. A/B порівнюй на однакових queries, перевір TTL/invalidation і rollback.

en.question: How are faithfulness and pipeline changes evaluated safely?
en.answer: Split answers into claims, inspect support/contradictions, count supported claims and citation coverage for source-requiring claims. Review samples with humans. Version the chunker, embeddings, corpus, index and reranker; changing embeddings usually requires reindexing. Compare A/B variants on identical queries and test TTL/invalidation and rollback.

uk.question: Як відокремити retrieval failure від generation failure?
uk.answer: Запускай retrieval-only eval; generator тестуй також із curated context. Relevant passage відсутній — retrieval/ingestion issue; passage присутній, answer wrong — context construction або generation. Додай no-answer, conflict, multilingual і ACL slices. Track quality, freshness, latency/cost і coverage незалежно; source truth не випливає з faithfulness.

en.question: How are retrieval and generation failures separated?
en.answer: Run retrieval-only evaluation and test the generator with curated contexts too. Missing relevant passages suggest retrieval/ingestion issues; present passages with wrong answers suggest context construction or generation issues. Add no-answer, conflict, multilingual and ACL slices. Track quality, freshness, latency/cost and coverage independently; faithfulness does not establish source truth.
